name: pitchonix
description: Fullstack SaaS platform for AI-powered business presentation generation

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.release:verify: npm run build && npm run lint && cd backend && npm test -- --runInBand && npm run certify:gate
scripts.release:certify:exports: cd backend && npm run certify:xlsx && npm run certify:pdf-binary
scripts.release:certify:v3: npm run release:verify && npm run release:certify:exports && npm run release:certify:e2e && npm run release:certify:visual && npm run release:certify:templates && npm run release:certify:auth && npm run release:certify:security && npm run release:certify:performance
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/.next backend/dist
